title: Free Zinger Burger with Minimum Order over $10 - Redeem via KFC App @ KFC
body:
Deal: Free Zinger Burger with Minimum Order over $10 - Redeem via KFC App @ KFC

[holdenmg] Sigh, scan the Image or use https://kfcau-web.app.link/e/HtdDKgBSO0b
[Think] Why the negs?
OP added the QR code link after my above comment. After I clicked the go to deal link, I see the burger picture. Then I clicked on the open the app link on the burger picture. I still can't find this offer in my app.
[puffinfresh] Read the text under the picture of the burger
[Think] @puffinfresh:
Scan QR code for a free Zinger…
I read what OP wrote the above.
[A 1] "1 redemption per recipient via KFC App. Min spend $10. Not everywhere and not forever. The promotion may take 24 hours to appear in your account. Offer is valid for 24 hours once promotion is activated."
[Think] Why the legs?
OP added the QR code link after my above comment.
[Poison Ivy] it says “get the app” and then just opens the app on the app store
[HaydosK] @Poison Ivy: Hmm does it show you any open in app popup?
[nightelves] @HaydosK: Anyway to get apps to open up directly rather tthan go through App store?
[Puglife] @nightelves: Try a different browser. Chrome worked for me. I assume you are using the Samsung browser
[Puglife] Use Chrome browser instead to click the link. It will open the app instead of the app store.
Still didnt add to my app, nor will I use it but hopefully this solves your issue👍
[bobthereviewer] Same issue here - even when they show it at the ground and scan these things. Gather it’s either an iOS or safari issue.
[Water Bearer] Think this is the July deal for the day.
Tomorrow says "Game Day deal" which is TBC. So this being a deal from the game. I'm gona go with logic
[Big-Deal] This is of course not the July deal for today
[simulacrum] On iOS just takes me to a page that says “get the app” and then just opens the app on the App Store. Both in chrome and safari
[holdenmg] One imagines that the app offer is limited by Geographic Location.
[JoeOz] Wouldn't it be TAS, since the game was there?
[Jayblesz] Can confirm it just opens the app and is unobtainable in WA.
[cooni] The format is wrong for a KFC app deeplink (on iOS at least).
The appropriate URL is https://kfcau.app.link/HtdDKgBSO0b
That said, it's not bringing up anything in my app. The promo appears valid because this is the branch.io promo data:
